# Massive Designer

> Massive's on-brand images, made from a link: put the values in the URL and it returns the finished JPG. No sign-in, no key.

## How to make an image

1. Pick an image. Templates are made to be filled in; the other images are finished designs that can be re-rendered with changes.
2. Build the link: `https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=<id>&<param>=<value>&…`
   - Use only that image's params. Leave a param out to keep its default.
   - URL-encode every value (a space is %20).
   - Text: as it should read, up to 300 characters. Select: one of the listed values. Toggle: true or false.
   - Photo: a public link to the image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF or SVG, up to 15 MB), not a page that shows it. Share pages from Unsplash, Google Drive or Dropbox (`dl=0`) won't work.
3. If the person attached the photo or has it on their computer, leave the photo param out and tell them: "Open the link and paste or drop your photo into the Photo field."
4. Give the person the link, as a plain link (not a markdown image). It opens the design in Massive Designer, filled in; they check the preview and click Download JPG.
5. For the finished JPG straight away, the same params work on `https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/<id>.jpg?<param>=<value>&…` (photo links only; `scale=1` for 1×, `download=1` to download). You don't need to open it yourself: it renders when the person clicks it.

Example: "A blog banner called 'Hotel Prices Without a Browser' with this photo: https://example.com/hotel.jpg"
- Link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=blog-banner&headline=Hotel%20Prices%20Without%20a%20Browser&photo=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fhotel.jpg
- JPG: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/blog-banner.jpg?headline=Hotel%20Prices%20Without%20a%20Browser&photo=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fhotel.jpg

Search every image: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/images?q=<words> (add &format=json for JSON). One image's details: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/images?id=<id>.

## Templates

### Birthday card

id `team-birthday` · 1080×1350 · team · template

A teammate's birthday: the character-sheet card with the day's quest, a maxed-out XP bar and reward chips over the dimmed Slack desktop, confetti frozen mid-burst. Source: public/video-projects/birthday; the default teammate (Franklin Uche, Community Lead) from image-projects/welcome-template.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A square portrait, face centred
- `name`: Full name. Text; default "Franklin Uche". First and last name; long names shrink to fit
- `firstName`: First name. Text; default "Franklin". Used in the birthday line
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Community Lead". Job title, about 30 characters
- `location`: Location. Text; default "Lagos, Nigeria". City, Country
- `quest`: Quest. Text; default "Eat cake. Make a wish.". One short line, up to about 60 characters
- `rewards`: Rewards (comma-separated, up to 5). Text; default "+1 Wisdom, +1 Cake, +100 Good vibes". Each one becomes a chip
- `confetti`: Confetti. True or false; default true. Frozen burst behind the photo; turn off for a calmer card

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/team-birthday.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=team-birthday
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/team-birthday/thumb.jpg

### Blog banner (template)

id `blog-banner` · 1376×768 · content · template

The joinmassive.com blog post banner (Sanity's Banner field), 1376×768: a photo with a dark wash from the left, the Massive logo and the headline in red-light. Use Strong wash for a bright photo. The photo recipe is in assets/photo-prompt.txt.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "Seltz: A Web Search API for LLMs". About 60 characters
- `position`: Headline position. One of `middle` (Middle), `bottom` (Bottom); default `middle`.
- `wash`: Wash. One of `standard` (Standard (dark photo)), `strong` (Strong (bright photo)); default `standard`. Strong for bright photos

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/blog-banner.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=blog-banner
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/blog-banner/thumb.jpg

### Blog quote card

id `content-blog-quote` · 1080×1350 · content · template

A pull quote from a Massive blog post with its author, the post's title and the blog link. Source: https://www.joinmassive.com/blog/is-robots-txt-legally-binding (quote, author, role and title as published, Oct 27, 2026).

Params:
- `quote`: Quote. Text; default "Is robots.txt legally binding? In the United States, not on its own.". Word for word from the post; up to about 200 characters, it shrinks to fit.
- `photo`: Author photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A square portrait; shown in a circle.
- `name`: Author. Text; default "Franklin Uche". The author's full name.
- `role`: Author's role. Text; default "Community Lead". A few words.
- `postTitle`: Post title. Text; default "Is robots.txt Legally Binding? What US and EU Courts Have Ruled". As published; up to two lines, about 90 characters.
- `link`: Link. Text; default "joinmassive.com/blog". Shown bottom right; keep it short, without https://.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/content-blog-quote.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=content-blog-quote
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/content-blog-quote/thumb.jpg

### Company page follower milestone

id `milestone-company-followers` · 1080×1350 · milestones · template

The Milestone card for the Massive LinkedIn company page: the Massive mark in the character-sheet card with the follower count, reward chips and a thank-you line, over the dimmed LinkedIn desktop. Source: image-projects/jason-15k-milestone; the follower counts are placeholders until the real number is in.

Params:
- `photo`: Logo or photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. The Massive mark by default; an SVG logo sits on the dark tile, a photo fills the frame
- `name`: Name. Text; default "Massive". The page's name
- `emoji`: Status emoji. Text; default "🎉". One emoji
- `status`: Status. Text; default "Celebrating a milestone". About 30 characters
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Company page". The red pill, a few words
- `count`: Followers. Text; default "[10,000]". The full count with a comma, e.g. 10,000
- `rewards`: Rewards (comma-separated, up to 5). Text; default "+1 Milestone, +∞ Thank yous". Each one becomes a chip
- `short`: Short count. Text; default "[10K]". For the thank-you line, e.g. 10K
- `confetti`: Confetti. True or false; default true. Frozen burst behind the photo; turn off for a calmer card

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/milestone-company-followers.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=milestone-company-followers
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/milestone-company-followers/thumb.jpg

### Data story stat

id `content-data-stat` · 1080×1350 · content · template

One finding from Massive research, its number big and a dot chart of it: one dot per item in the total, the finding's share lit red. Source: https://www.joinmassive.com/blog/edpb-web-scraping-guidelines (Massive's robots.txt check of 47 news sites, October 26, 2026: 42 block at least one AI training crawler).

Params:
- `value`: Value. Text; default "42". A whole number; that many dots are lit red.
- `total`: Total. Text; default "47". A whole number; the chart draws one dot each, up to 400.
- `label`: What it counts. Text; default "news sites block at least one AI training crawler". Reads after “42 of 47”; up to three lines, about 60 characters.
- `source`: Source. Text; default "Massive, EDPB Web Scraping Guidelines: What the GDPR Draft Means for AI Data Collection". Who published it and where, after “Source:”.
- `link`: Source link. Text; default "joinmassive.com/blog/edpb-web-scraping-guidelines". The page the number comes from, without https://.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/content-data-stat.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=content-data-stat
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/content-data-stat/thumb.jpg

### Event recap

id `events-recap` · 1080×1350 · events · template

Event recap in the house look: three photos from the event, a thank-you headline, the event line and one takeaway. Source: scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html (Prague Crawl 2026, May 20, 2026; 250+ attendees; 17 talks, demos and a panel) and praguecrawl.com/agenda; photos from public/image-projects/_prague-crawl/.

Params:
- `event`: Event line. Text; default "Prague Crawl 2026 · May 20, 2026". Event name · date, about 35 characters
- `photo1`: Top photo. A direct https:// link to an image, or one of the design's photos by name: `The room`, `Talk from the back`, `Speaker and audience`, `Panel on stage`, `Networking`, `Filming a talk`; default: the design's own. The wide photo on top; a landscape shot of the whole room works best
- `photo2`: Left photo. A direct https:// link to an image, or one of the design's photos by name: `The room`, `Talk from the back`, `Speaker and audience`, `Panel on stage`, `Networking`, `Filming a talk`; default: the design's own. Lower left; a landscape photo
- `photo3`: Right photo. A direct https:// link to an image, or one of the design's photos by name: `The room`, `Talk from the back`, `Speaker and audience`, `Panel on stage`, `Networking`, `Filming a talk`; default: the design's own. Lower right; a landscape photo
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "Thank you, Prague". The thank-you line. Up to two lines; about 20 characters reads best
- `takeaway`: Takeaway. Text; default "250+ attendees. 17 talks, demos and a panel.". One or two sourced facts, up to two lines; about 50 characters

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/events-recap.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=events-recap
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/events-recap/thumb.jpg

### Hiring: Photo (template)

id `hiring-photo-square` · 1080×1080 · hiring · template

The square hiring post: “We’re hiring” and the role on a red brush stroke, on a cream wash beside the photo, and a handwritten note with an arrow. Fill in the role and the note, and pick one of the hiring photos (../_hiring/) or upload one; ../_hiring/hiring.js fits the wash, the photo and the arrow to it.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image, or one of the design's photos by name: `Home office`, `Standing call`, `Window seat (SF)`, `Standing desk`, `Coffee at the desk`, `At an event`, `Leaning back`, `Home lab`, `Café`, `On the sofa`, `Balcony abroad`, `Kitchen at sunrise`, `Hammock`; default: the design's own. Pick one of the hiring photos, or upload your own: subject on the right, an empty bright left side.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "We’re hiring".
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Writer in Residence". On the red stroke; up to two lines, it shrinks to fit.
- `aside`: Handwritten note. Text; default "Pajamas: approved.". A short joke about the photo, like “Socks: mismatched.”; the arrow points into the photo.
- `showAside`: Show the note. True or false; default true.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/hiring-photo-square.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=hiring-photo-square
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/hiring-photo-square/thumb.jpg

### Market map teaser

id `content-market-map-teaser` · 1080×1350 · content · template

A teaser for a new market map: the headline and the count over a cropped preview of the map, fading into the ground, and “Full map in the comments”. The default map is the AI Agents example (15 categories, 88 companies) downloaded from the Market Map tool, Dark, Vertical. Source: src/tools/market-map/app/constants.ts (the AI Agents example sheet).

Params:
- `map`: Map. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. The Market Map tool's Download JPG, Vertical; only its top part shows.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "AI agent market map". The map's name; up to two lines, about 30 characters.
- `count`: Count. Text; default "88 companies, 15 categories". What the map holds, from the tool's sidebar; one line.
- `cta`: Call to action. Text; default "Full map in the comments". Where the full map is; about 25 characters.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/content-market-map-teaser.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=content-market-map-teaser

### Meet us at …

id `events-meet-us` · 1080×1350 · events · template

Conference card in the house look: the event's name big, when and where, where to find us there and who's going, with an optional second person. Source: scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html (Prague Crawl 2027, May 13, 2027, Spojka Events, Prague; citing praguecrawl.com).

Params:
- `eyebrow`: Eyebrow. Text; default "Meet us at". Two to four words: Meet us at, See you at
- `event`: Event. Text; default "Prague Crawl 2027". The event's name. Up to two lines; about 30 characters reads best
- `date`: Date. Text; default "May 13, 2027". The day or days, e.g. May 13, 2027
- `venue`: City or venue. Text; default "Spojka Events, Prague". Venue and city, about 30 characters
- `spot`: Where to find us. Text; default "[Booth or spot]". Booth number or spot at the venue, about 40 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. Square portrait, face centred; cropped to a circle
- `name`: Name. Text; default "Jason Grad". Full name, about 25 characters
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Co-founder & CEO". Job title, about 40 characters
- `second`: Second person. True or false; default false. Adds a second person under the first
- `photo2`: Second photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. Square portrait, face centred; shown when Second person is on
- `name2`: Second name. Text; default "Franklin Uche". Full name, about 25 characters
- `role2`: Second role. Text; default "Community Lead". Job title, about 40 characters

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/events-meet-us.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=events-meet-us
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/events-meet-us/thumb.jpg

### Prague Crawl 2027: speaker card

id `prague-crawl-2027-speaker` · 1080×1080 · events · template

Announce a confirmed speaker: their photo in a gradient ring on the left, and Speaker, their name, company logo and role on the right, in the Prague Crawl look (_prague-crawl/). Fill in one per speaker. The default is Jason Grad as an example.

Params:
- `eyebrow`: Eyebrow. Text; default "Speaker". One or two words, in capitals: Speaker, Keynote, Panelist, Demo.
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A square portrait with the face centred, at least 900 px wide; it's cropped to a circle.
- `name`: Name. Text; default "Jason Grad". Full name, in capitals. Wraps to two lines and shrinks to fit.
- `logo`: Company logo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. The company's logo for dark backgrounds (white or colour on black), PNG or SVG, wider than tall.
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Co-Founder & CEO". Job title only; the logo shows the company. Up to about 40 characters.
- `date`: Date. Text; default "May 13, 2027".
- `venue`: Venue. Text; default "Spojka Events, Prague".

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/prague-crawl-2027-speaker.jpg

### Prague Crawl 2027: sponsor welcome

id `prague-crawl-2027-sponsor` · 1080×1080 · events · template

Welcome a sponsor as they sign: Sponsored by, their logo straight on the black, and their tier, in the Prague Crawl look (_prague-crawl/). It's the LinkedIn co-post (Platinum, Gold) or mention (Silver, Bronze) from the deck's benefits table (scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html). The default, Apify as a Gold sponsor, is only an example.

Params:
- `eyebrow`: Eyebrow. Text; default "Sponsored by". Two or three words, in capitals.
- `logo`: Sponsor logo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. The sponsor's logo for dark backgrounds (white or colour on a transparent background), PNG or SVG.
- `tier`: Tier. One of `platinum` (Platinum sponsor), `gold` (Gold sponsor), `silver` (Silver sponsor), `bronze` (Bronze sponsor), `afterparty` (Afterparty Partner), `coffee` (Coffee & Lunch Partner), `none` (No tier line); default `gold`. The line under the logo.
- `date`: Date. Text; default "May 13, 2027".
- `venue`: Venue. Text; default "Spojka Events, Prague".

### Role filled: we hired!

id `hiring-we-hired` · 1080×1080 · hiring · template

Closes the loop on a role post once it is filled: “We hired” and the role on the red brush stroke, beside the photo, with a handwritten note; follow it with the person’s Welcome to Massive card. Source: welcome-template (Franklin Uche, Community Lead).

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image, or one of the design's photos by name: `Home office`, `Standing call`, `Window seat (SF)`, `Standing desk`, `Coffee at the desk`, `At an event`, `Leaning back`, `Home lab`, `Café`, `On the sofa`, `Balcony abroad`, `Kitchen at sunrise`, `Hammock`; default: the design's own. Pick one of the hiring photos, or upload your own: subject on the right, an empty bright left side.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "We hired". Keep it short; a long word shrinks to stay clear of the photo.
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Community Lead". The role that was filled, as it was posted; on the red stroke, up to two lines, it shrinks to fit.
- `aside`: Handwritten note. Text; default "Desk: taken.". A short joke about the photo, like “Desk: taken.”; the arrow points into the photo.
- `showAside`: Show the note. True or false; default true. Hide the note and its arrow.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/hiring-we-hired.jpg

- `date`: Date. Text; default "[Date]". Day, date and time, e.g. Thu, March 4 · 7 pm. Leave the brackets until it's known
- `area`: Neighborhood. Text; default "[Neighborhood]". Neighborhood or venue, about 30 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known
- `rsvp`: RSVP link. Text; default "[RSVP link]". A short link without https://, about 30 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known

### Speaker card

id `events-speaker` · 1080×1350 · events · template

- `name`: Name. Text; default "Jason Grad". Full name, about 25 characters
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Co-founder & CEO, Massive". Job title and company, about 40 characters
- `event`: Event. Text; default "Prague Crawl 2027". The event's name, about 25 characters
- `date`: Date. Text; default "May 13, 2027". e.g. May 13, 2027
- `time`: Time. Text; default "[Time]". Start time and time zone, e.g. 11:10 CET. Leave the brackets until it's known
- `venue`: Venue. Text; default "Spojka Events, Prague". Venue and city, about 30 characters

### Teammate spotlight Q&A

id `team-spotlight` · 1080×1350 · team · template

One teammate in the character-sheet card, with three short questions and answers where the welcome card has its abilities, over the dimmed Slack desktop. Source: image-projects/welcome-template (Franklin Uche's role, hobbies and favourite food).

- `firstName`: First name. Text; default "Franklin". Used in the "Meet" line
- `country`: Country. Text; default "Nigeria". In English; it picks the flag
- `q1`: Question 1. Text; default "Role". A short label, up to about 30 characters; the first one usually says what they do
- `a1`: Answer 1. Text; default "Community Lead". Up to two lines, about 70 characters
- `q2`: Question 2. Text; default "Outside work". A short label, up to about 30 characters
- `a2`: Answer 2. Text; default "Football, golf and gardening". Up to two lines, about 70 characters
- `q3`: Question 3. Text; default "Fuel". A short label, up to about 30 characters

### Webinar

id `events-webinar` · 1920×1080 · events · template

Landscape webinar card in the house look: the title big, the speaker's photo, name and role beside it, and the date, time and registration link (placeholders until they're set). Source: https://www.joinmassive.com/blog/is-robots-txt-legally-binding (the default topic, by Franklin Uche, Community Lead).

Params:
- `eyebrow`: Eyebrow. Text; default "Webinar". One or two words: Webinar, Live session
- `title`: Title. Text; default "Is robots.txt legally binding?". Up to three lines; about 40 characters reads best
- `photo`: Speaker photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. Square portrait, face centred
- `name`: Speaker name. Text; default "Franklin Uche". Full name, about 20 characters
- `role`: Speaker role. Text; default "Community Lead". Job title, about 30 characters
- `date`: Date. Text; default "[Date]". e.g. Thu, November 12. Leave the brackets until it's known
- `time`: Time and time zone. Text; default "[Time and time zone]". e.g. 5 pm CET / 11 am ET. Leave the brackets until it's known
- `register`: Registration link. Text; default "[Registration link]". A short link without https://, about 30 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/events-webinar.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=events-webinar
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/events-webinar/thumb.jpg

### Welcome to Massive: Template (Franklin)

id `welcome-template` · 1080×1350 · team · template

A new teammate's character-sheet card over the dimmed Slack desktop, with the welcome line below: the Welcome to Massive video held still in the Milestone card's layout. Fill in a new hire's details and photo.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A portrait
- `badge`: Badge. Text; default "New hire".
- `name`: Full name. Text; default "Franklin Uche".
- `firstName`: First name. Text; default "Franklin". Used in the welcome line
- `status`: Status. Text; default "Available".
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Community Lead".
- `country`: Country. Text; default "Nigeria". In English; it picks the flag
- `hobbies`: Abilities (comma-separated, up to 5). Text; default "Playing football, Playing golf, Gardening". Each one becomes a chip
- `food`: Fuel (favourite food). Text; default "Medium rare steak and rice".
- `confetti`: Confetti. True or false; default true.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/welcome-template.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=welcome-template
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/welcome-template/thumb.jpg

### Where the team is

id `team-world-map` · 1080×1350 · team · template

Where the team works from: a world map with the team's countries in red, a flag chip for each, and the country count in the headline, all from one comma-separated list. The default list is the countries on the Welcome to Massive cards, only part of the team. Source: public/image-projects/welcome-* (each card's country field).

Params:
- `countries`: Countries. Text; default "Ukraine, Poland, Italy, Brazil, Finland, Canada, USA, Nigeria". Every country the team works from, comma-separated, in English; 1 to 25, each one a chip and a red country.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "{N} countries, one team". {N} becomes the number of countries, in red; up to two lines.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/team-world-map.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=team-world-map
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/team-world-map/thumb.jpg

### Work anniversary

id `team-work-anniversary` · 1080×1350 · team · template

A teammate's work anniversary: the achievement toast and the character-sheet card with their years at Massive as lit pips, over the dimmed Slack desktop. Source: public/video-projects/work-anniversary; the default teammate (Franklin Uche, Community Lead) from image-projects/welcome-template.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A square portrait, face centred
- `name`: Full name. Text; default "Franklin Uche". First and last name; long names shrink to fit
- `firstName`: First name. Text; default "Franklin". Used in the anniversary line
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Community Lead". Job title, about 30 characters
- `years`: Years at Massive. Text; default "3". A whole number; it sets the pips, the tenure and the toast

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/team-work-anniversary.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=team-work-anniversary
